Private Function Cells(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal address As String) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range(address)
        s = s & ";" & c.Address(False, False) & "=" & TypeName(c.Value) & ":" & c.Formula
    Next
    Cells = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, answer As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "Sheet1"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        wb.Names.Add "Zed", "=Sheet1!$A$1"
        wb.Names.Add "alpha", "=10"
        ws.Names.Add "Local", "=Sheet1!$B$2"
        wb.Names.Add "Hidden", "=5", Visible:=False
        wb.Names.Add "Mid", "=SUM(Sheet1!$A$1:$A$3)"
        ws.Range("D2").ListNames
        answer = Cells(ws, "D1:F7")
    Case 1
        ws.Range("D2:E3").ListNames
        answer = Cells(ws, "D1:E3")
    Case 2
        wb.Names.Add "One", "=1"
        ws.Range("D2:E3").ListNames
        answer = Cells(ws, "D1:E3")
    Case 3
        wb.Names.Add "One", "=1"
        ws.Range("D2").Value = "keep"
        ws.Range("E2").Value = "keep"
        ws.Range("D3").Value = "keep"
        ws.Range("D2").ListNames
        answer = Cells(ws, "D1:E3")
    Case 4
        wb.Names.Add "One", "=1"
        ws.Range("D2,G2").ListNames
        answer = Cells(ws, "D1:H3")
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "Apple"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = "Apricot"
        ws.Range("A3").Value = "Banana"
        ws.Range("A5").Value = "blueberry"
        ws.Range("A6").Value = 123
        answer = ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("b") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("ap") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("app") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("Ban") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("x") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("1") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("BLUE") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("apple") & "|" & ws.Range("B4").AutoComplete("ap")
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "Apple"
        ws.Range("A3").Value = "Apple pie"
        answer = ws.Range("A2").AutoComplete("app") & "|" & ws.Range("A10").AutoComplete("app") & "|" & ws.Range("A4").AutoComplete("Apple ")
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "Apple"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = "apple"
        answer = ws.Range("A3").AutoComplete("a")
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "Apple"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = "Apricot"
        Application.EnableAutoComplete = False
        answer = ws.Range("A3").AutoComplete("app")
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "Apple"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = ""
        ws.Range("A4").Value = "Apricot"
        answer = ws.Range("A3").AutoComplete("apr") & "|" & ws.Range("A3").AutoComplete("appl")
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "Apple"
        answer = ws.Range("A1:A2").AutoComplete("ap")
    Case 11
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "20261029 Smith   0042"
        ws.Range("A1").Parse "[xxxxxxxx] [xxxxxxxx][xxxx]"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:E1")
    Case 12
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "20261029 Smith   0042"
        ws.Range("A1").Parse "[xxxxxxxx][xxxxxxxxx][xxxx]"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:E1")
    Case 13
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "abcdefgh"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = "ijklmnop"
        ws.Range("A1:A2").Parse "[xx][xxx]"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:D2")
    Case 14
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "abcdefgh"
        ws.Range("A1").Parse "[xx][xxx]", ws.Range("C5")
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:F5")
    Case 15
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "abcdefgh"
        ws.Range("A1").Parse
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:D1")
    Case 16
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "abcdefgh"
        ws.Range("A1").Parse "xx"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:D1")
    Case 17
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "abcdefgh"
        ws.Range("A1:B1").Parse "[xx][xx]"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:D1")
    Case 18
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "0042abc"
        ws.Range("A1").Parse "[xxxx][xxx]"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:C1")
    Case 19
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 12345678
        ws.Range("A1").Parse "[xxxx][xxxx]"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:C1")
    Case 20
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "ab"
        ws.Range("A1").Parse "[xxxx][xxxx]"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:C1")
    Case 21
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "abcdefgh"
        ws.Range("A1").Parse "[xx]  [xx]"
        answer = Cells(ws, "A1:C1")
    End Select
    Tried = answer
Done:
    Application.EnableAutoComplete = True
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 21
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
